answer.reason: Tirzah was a royal seat of Israel where Baasha reigned, Elah was murdered, and Omri besieged the city.

clauses.english: was where Baasha began to reign over all Israel
clauses.quote: began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah

clauses.english: was where King Elah was murdered by Zimri
clauses.quote: Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him

clauses.english: was besieged and taken by Omri
clauses.quote: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah

doubts: JOS 12:24 (king of Tirzah in a list), 1KI 14:17 (Jeroboam's child died there), 1KI 16:23 (Omri reigned there) and SNG 6:4 (a comparison) were left out as minor or not events.
